name: Darkness
description: Summons darkness around you in an 8 yd radius, granting friendly targets a 15% chance to avoid all damage from an attack. Lasts 8 sec.\n\nChance to avoid damage increased by 100% when not in a raid.

name: The Hunt
description: Charge to your target, striking them for 2,282 Cosmic damage, rooting them in place for 1.5 sec and inflicting 1,628 Cosmic damage over 6 sec to up to 5 enemies in your path.

name: Imprison
description: Imprisons a demon, beast, or humanoid, incapacitating them for 1 min. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1.

name: Void Nova
description: Unleash an eruption of void energy, dealing 104 Cosmic damage and stunning your target and all nearby enemies for 2 sec.

name: Consume Magic
description: Consume 1 beneficial Magic effect removing it from the target.

name: Vengeful Retreat
description: Remove all snares and vault away. Nearby enemies take 5 Physical damage.

name: Collapsing Star
description:
While in Void Metamorphosis, every 30 Soul Fragments harvested grants access to Collapsing Star.

 Collapsing Star
Channel an immense amount of void energy into a single, cataclysmic blast, dealing 2,443 Cosmic damage to your target and 1,772 Cosmic damage to all nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

While casting Collapsing Star, your Fury drain is significantly reduced.

name: Sigil of Misery
description: Place a Sigil of Misery at the target location that activates after 2 sec.\n\nCauses all enemies affected by the sigil to cower in fear, disorienting them for 15 sec.

name: Soul Immolation
description: Light your soul aflame, healing yourself for 24% of your maximum health, generating 30 Fury and shattering 3 Soul Fragments over 5 sec.

name: Void Metamorphosis
description:
Collecting 50 Soul Fragments grants access to Void Metamorphosis.

 Void Metamorphosis
Requires 50 Soul Fragments

You ascend to a higher state of being, substantially empowering your abilities.

While in Void Metamorphosis, your Consume and Reap are enhanced and your Fury will slowly drain. Additionally, Void Ray reduces your Fury drain, deals increased damage, and no longer consumes Fury.

name: Void Ray
description:
Requires 100 Fury
Unleash a beam of concentrated void energy, dealing 76 Cosmic damage and consuming 5 Fury every 0.1 sec.

Effect ends after 2.7 sec or upon reaching 0 Fury.

name: Voidblade
description: Unleash your glaives and charge to your target, dealing 852 Cosmic damage.

name: Metamorphosis
description: Leap into the air and land with explosive force, dealing 15 Chaos damage to enemies within 8 yds, and stunning them for 3 sec. Players are Dazed for 3 sec instead.\n\nUpon landing, you are transformed into a hellish demon for 20 sec, greatly empowering your Chaos Strike and Blade Dance abilities and gaining 20% Haste.

name: Fury of the Illidari
description: Throws two demonic glaives in a whirlwind of energy, causing 0 Chaos damage over 3 sec to all nearby enemies.

name: Soul Carver
description: Carve into the soul of your target, dealing 171 Fire damage and an additional 104 Fire damage over 3 sec.  Immediately shatters 3 Soul Fragments from the target and 1 additional Soul Fragment every 1 sec.

name: Spectral Sight
description: Allows you to see enemies and treasures through physical barriers, as well as enemies that are stealthed and invisible. Lasts 8 sec.\n\nLoss of control effects disrupt the sight.

name: Disrupt
description: Interrupts the enemy's spellcasting and locks them from that school of magic for 5 sec.

name: Immolation Aura
description: Engulf yourself in flames, radiating 26 Fire damage over 6 sec.

name: Fel Rush
description: Rush forward, incinerating anything in your path for 15 Chaos damage.

name: Glide
description: Reduces your falling speed.\n\nYou can activate this ability with the jump key while falling.

name: Shift
description: Shift through the void, reappearing at your targeted destination.

name: Blur
description: Reduces all damage taken by 25% for 10 sec.

name: Chaos Strike
description: Slice your target for 28 Chaos damage. Chaos Strike has a 20% chance to refund 20 Fury.

name: Consume
description:
Drain the essence from your target, dealing 1,200 Cosmic damage.

Castable while moving.

Generates 8 Fury.

name: Demon's Bite
description: Quickly attack for 36 Physical damage.\n\nGenerates 20 to 30 Fury.

name: Reap
description: Cut a hole in the fabric of reality, sending a concentrated bolt of cosmic matter towards your target, dealing 2,404 Cosmic damage.\n\nReap gathers up to 4 nearby souls.

name: Sigil of Flame
description:
Place a Sigil of Flame at the target location that activates after 2 sec.

Deals 28 Fire damage, and an additional 70 Fire damage over 8 sec, to all enemies affected by the sigil.

Generates 25 Fury.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Throw Glaive
description: Throw a demonic glaive at the target, dealing 17 Physical damage. The glaive can ricochet to an additional enemy within 10 yards.

name: Torment
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Reverse Magic
description: Removes all harmful magical effects from yourself and all nearby allies within 10 yards, and sends them back to their original caster if possible.

name: Armor of Souls
description: Your Armor is increased by 100%. Taking damage has a 12% chance to generate a Soul Fragment.

name: Beckon
description: Reap reduces the cast time of your next Consume by 100% and causes it to generate 1 additional Soul Fragment.

name: Cleansed by Flame
description: Immolation Aura dispels a magical effect on you when cast.

name: Cover of Darkness
description: The radius of Darkness is increased by 4 yds, and its duration by 2 sec.

name: Detainment
description: Imprison's PvP duration is increased by 1 sec, and targets become immune to damage and healing while imprisoned.

name: Glimpse
description: Vengeful Retreat provides immunity to loss of control effects, and reduces damage taken by 25% until you land.

name: Inevitable End
description: Collapsing Star can no longer be interrupted and its cast time is reduced by 25%.

name: Surrender to the Void
description: Void Metamorphosis requires 50 additional souls.\n\nWhile in Void Metamorphosis, your damage is increased by 10% and effects that grant you Fury grant 100% additional Fury.

name: Aldrachi Design
description: Increases your chance to parry by 3%.

name: Aura of Pain
description: Increases the critical strike chance of Immolation Aura by 6%.

name: Blazing Path
description: Shift gains an additional charge.

name: Blind Focus
description: Cosmic damage increased by 2%.\n\nEffect is doubled while in demon form.

name: Bouncing Glaives
description: Throw Glaive ricochets to 1 additional target.

name: Burn It Out
description: Immolation Aura removes 1 Disease effect.

name: Burning Blades
description: Your blades burn with Cosmic energy, causing your Voidblade, Hungering Slash, and Throw Glaive to deal an additional 35% damage as Cosmic damage.\n\nReap damage increased by 20%.

name: Calamitous
description: Your damaging critical strikes deal 240% damage instead of the usual 200%.

name: Catastrophe
description: Enemies struck by a Voidfall Meteor take an additional 25% damage over 8 sec.

name: Celestial Echoes
description: Consume generates 2 additional Fury and deals 15% increased damage.

name: Champion of the Glaive
description: Throw Glaive has 2 charges and 10 yard increased range.

name: Charred Warblades
description: You heal for 3% of all Fire damage you deal.

name: Dark Matter
description: Your first Collapsing Star after casting Void Metamorphosis causes a Cosmic meteor shower to assault the area, dealing 2,247 Cosmic damage over 6 sec.

name: Demon Muzzle
description: Interrupting a spell with Disrupt decreases your magic damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.

name: Demonic Instinct
description: Void Ray and Hungering Slash damage increased by 10%.

name: Demonic Intensity
description: Activating Void Metamorphosis greatly empowers The Hunt.\n\nVoidsurge damage is increased by 10% for each time it previously triggered while your demon form is active.

name: Demonic Resilience
description: Blur gains 1 additional charge.

name: Devourer's Bite
description: Damage from Voidblade and the Hunt increases the damage your target takes from you by 12% for 10 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

name: Devourer's Edge
description: Reap and Consume damage increased by 10%.

name: Disrupting Fury
description: Disrupt generates 30 Fury on a successful interrupt.

name: Doomsayer
description: Activating Void Ray out of combat or within 5 sec of entering combat calls down 3 Voidfall Meteors over its duration.

name: Duty Eternal
description: Voidblade damage increased by 100% and Voidblade now generates 20 Fury.

name: Emptiness
description: Every soul consumed in Void Metamorphosis grants 0.25% haste, up to 25%.

name: Enduring Torment
description: The effects of your demon form persist outside of it in a weakened state, increasing Mastery: Monster Within's effectiveness by 20%.

name: Entropy
description: While in combat, generate 1 Soul Fragment every 12 sec.\n\nWhile out of combat, you will slowly build towards your Void Metamorphosis, up to 25 Soul Fragments.

name: Eradicate
description:
Fully channeling Void Ray upgrades your Reap to Eradicate.

 Eradicate
Slam your Scythe to the ground, dealing 2,404 Cosmic damage to your primary target and 2,043 to all other enemies within a 25 yd cone in front of you. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Eradicate gathers up to 4 nearby souls.

name: Erratic Felheart
description: The cooldown of Fel Rush is reduced by 1.0 sec.

name: Feast of Souls
description: Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

name: Felfire Haste
description: Fel Rush increases your movement speed by 10% for 8 sec.

name: Final Breath
description: Fully channeling Void Ray increases the damage of its final tick by 300%.

name: Final Hour
description: Passive bonuses granted by each stack of Voidfall persist for 8 sec after being consumed.

name: First In, Last Out
description: Shift grants you a rapidly decaying shield equal to 6% of your maximum health.

name: Flamebound
description: Hungering Slash has 2 yd increased radius and 50% increased critical strike damage bonus.

name: Focused Hatred
description: Voidsurge deals 50% increased damage when it strikes a single target.\n\nEach additional target reduces this bonus by 10%.

name: Focused Ire
description: The primary target of Chaos Nova is stunned for an additional 2 sec.

name: Focused Ray
description: Void Ray deals 80% more damage when damaging 3 targets.

name: Furious
description: Attacks and abilities that generate Fury deal 3% increased damage.

name: Gift of the Void
description: Your critical strike chance is increased by 2%.

name: Guile
description: The cast range of Voidblade, Consume Magic, and Disrupt are increased by 20 yds.

name: Harness the Cosmos
description: Voidfall Meteor damage increased by 15%.

name: Hungering Slash
description:
After dealing damage with The Hunt or Voidblade, Voidblade is replaced with Hungering Slash for 6 sec.

 Hungering Slash
Violently slash your scythe around you, dealing 940 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies and generating 10 Fury. Shatters up to 2 Soul Fragments from nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

Hungering Slash grants a temporary charge of Vengeful Retreat and causes your next Vengeful Retreat within 6 sec to deal an additional 570 Cosmic damage.

name: Illidari Knowledge
description: Reduces magic damage taken by 3%.

name: Impending Apocalypse
description: Each Collapsing Star you cast increases the damage of your next Collapsing Star by 20%.

name: Improved Consume
description: Consume deals 10% increased damage and its cast time is reduced by 0.25 sec.

name: Improved Disrupt
description: Increases the range of Disrupt to 10 yds.

name: Improved Sigil of Misery
description: Reduces the cooldown of Sigil of Misery by 30 sec.

name: Improved Soul Rending
description: Leech granted by Soul Rending increased by 2% and an additional 2% while Void Metamorphosis is active.

name: Infernal Armor
description: Immolation Aura increases your armor by 20% and causes melee attackers to suffer 4 Fire damage.

name: Internal Struggle
description: Increases your mastery by 2.6%.

name: Live by the Glaive
description: When you parry an attack or have one of your attacks parried, restore 2% of max health and 10 Fury. \n\nThis effect may only occur once every 5 sec.

name: Long Night
description: Increases the duration of Darkness by 3 sec.

name: Lost in Darkness
description: Spectral Sight has 5 sec reduced cooldown and no longer reduces movement speed.

name: Mass Acceleration
description: Gain 3 stacks of Voidfall and reset the cooldown of Reap upon activating Void Metamorphosis.

name: Master of the Glaive
description: Throw Glaive has 2 charges and snares all enemies hit by 50% for 6 sec.

name: Meteoric Fall
description: While at 3 stacks of Voidfall, Reap consumes all 3 to rapidly call down that many meteor strikes.

name: Meteoric Rise
description: Void Ray damage increased by 15%.\n\nFully channeling Void Ray generates 1 stack of Voidfall.

name: Midnight
description: Collapsing Star always critically strikes.

name: Moment of Craving
description: After fully channeling Void Ray, the cooldown of Reap is reset and your next Reap will collect up to 6 additional Soul Fragments.

name: Monster Rising
description: Intellect increased by 15% while not in demon form.

name: Otherworldly Focus
description: Collapsing Star and Voidfall meteors deal 30% increased damage when striking a single target.\n\nEach additional target reduces this bonus by 5%.

name: Path to Oblivion
description: Each stack of Voidfall grants 3% increased movement speed.

name: Phase Shift
description: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% reduced damage taken.

name: Pitch Black
description: Reduces the cooldown of Darkness by 120 sec.

name: Predator's Thirst
description: Consume damage increased by 15%.\n\nConsume generates a Soul Fragment.

name: Pursuit
description: Mastery increases your movement speed.

name: Pursuit of Angriness
description: Movement speed increased by 1% per 10 Fury.

name: Remorseless
description: Attacks and abilities that spend Fury deal 3% increased damage.

name: Rolling Torment
description: When Void Metamorphosis expires, for each unused Soul you harvested, gain 5 Fury and increase your damage by 0.50% for 12 sec.

name: Scythe's Embrace
description: Reap now generates 10 Fury.

name: Second Helping
description: Reap gains an additional charge.

name: Set Fire to the Pain
description: 5% of all non-Fire damage taken is instead taken as Fire damage over 6 sec.\n\nFire damage taken reduced by 10%.

name: Shattered Restoration
description: The healing of Shattered Souls is increased by 10%.

name: Singed Spirit
description: Soul Immolation generates an additional 12 Fury over its duration.

name: Singular Strikes
description: Voidblade damage increased by 25%.\n\nHungering Slash deals 50% increased damage to its primary target.

name: Soul Cleanse
description: Immolation Aura removes 1 Curse effect.

name: Soul Glutton
description: Void Metamorphosis requires 15 less souls.\n\nYour Fury drains 25% faster while in Void Metamorphosis.

name: Soul Rending
description: Leech increased by 6%.\n\nGain an additional 6% leech while Metamorphosis is active.

name: Soul Splitter
description: Any time you would generate one or more Soul Fragments, you have a 2% chance to generate an additional Soul Fragment.

name: Soulforged Blades
description: Hungering Slash and Voidblade's critical strike chance is increased by 15%.

name: Soulshaper
description: Each Soul Fragment gathered by Reap increases its damage by 8%.

name: Spontaneous Immolation
description: Soul Immolation heals for an additional 6% of your health over its duration and its cooldown is reset upon killing an enemy that yields experience or honor.

name: Star Fragments
description: Collapsing Star now generates 3 Soul Fragments.

name: State of Matter
description: Shift has 1 additional charge.

name: Student of Suffering
description: Void Ray applies Student of Suffering to you, increasing Mastery by 10.6% and granting 5 Fury every 2 sec, for 6 sec.

name: Swallowed Anger
description: Consume Magic generates 20 Fury when a beneficial Magic effect is successfully removed from the target.

name: Sweet Release
description: Your chance to shatter a Soul Fragment from enemies you damage is increased by 2%.

name: Sweet Suffering
description:
The duration of Feast of Souls is increased by 1 sec.

 Feast of Souls
Soul Fragments grant 1% increased damage for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

name: Swift Erasure
description: Each stack of Voidfall grants 2% Haste.

name: Tempered Soul
description: The cooldown of Soul Immolation is reduced by 30 sec and it gains 1 additional charge.

name: Umbral Blade
description: Reap's cooldown is reduced by your Haste.

name: Undying Embers
description: Soul Immolation has a 25% chance to reignite after it expires, reapplying its effect.

name: Unrestrained Fury
description: Increases maximum Fury by 20.

name: Untethered Fury
description: Maximum Fury increased by 20.

name: Vengeful Bonds
description: Vengeful Retreat reduces the movement speed of all nearby enemies by 70% for 3 sec.

name: Violent Transformation
description: Entering Void Metamorphosis resets the cooldown of Voidblade and The Hunt.\n\nThe Hunt deals 25% increased damage and resets the cooldown of Soul Immolation.

name: Voidfall
description: Consume has a 35% chance to grant 1 stack of Voidfall.\n\nUpon reaching 3 stacks of Voidfall, Reap consumes a stack to reach into the Void and call down a meteor strike at your target's location, dealing 665 Cosmic damage to all enemies within 8 yards. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Voidglare Boon
description: After fully channeling Void Ray, gain 10 Fury.

name: Voidpurge
description: Void Ray's cooldown during Void Metamorphosis is reduced by 2.0 sec.

name: Voidrage
description: Your Mastery is increased by 2%.

name: Voidrush
description: Collapsing Star reduces the cooldown of Voidblade by 10 sec.\n\nVoidblade and The Hunt briefly reduce your Fury drain while in Void Metamorphosis.

name: Voidsurge
description: Void Metamorphosis now also greatly empowers Voidblade and Hungering Slash.\n\nWhile demon form is active, the first cast of each empowered ability induces a Voidsurge, causing you to explode with Void energy, dealing 2,360 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Volatile Instinct
description: Entering demon form causes your next Voidsurge to repeat after a short delay.

name: Waste Not
description: Damage from Void Ray has a 200% increased chance to generate a Soul Fragment.

name: Wave of Debilitation
description: Chaos Nova slows enemies by 60% and reduces attack and cast speed by 15% for 5 sec after its stun fades.

name: Will of the Illidari
description: Increases maximum health by 3%.

name: Wings of Wrath
description: Glide speed increased by 10%.

name: World Killer
description: The third Voidfall meteor strike called down in sequence is larger, has 50% increased area, deals 50% increased damage, and generates 1 Soul Fragment.

name: Demon Hunter Devourer 12.1 Class Set 2pc
description: Harvesting 4 or more Soul Fragments with Reap has a 20% chance to cause your next Consume to be instant cast and explode in a Soulburst, dealing 2,303 Cosmic damage to nearby enemies.

name: Shattered Souls
description:
Damaging an enemy has a 4% chance to shatter a lesser soul fragment from them.

 Soul Fragment:
A fragment of your enemy's soul. Walking into the soul or casting Reap will collect it, granting you 4 Fury and healing you for 1% of your maximum health.
